IVX FINAL CORE CLOSEOUT — MULTIPLE TESTS, ZERO GAPS, IOS/STORE DEFERRED

OWNER DIRECTIVE

iOS, TestFlight, App Store, and Google Play release certification are DEFERRED.

Do NOT treat them as blockers for this core IVX certification.

The objective now is to complete all remaining production, autonomy, reliability, security, Android, and Rork-independence gaps end-to-end.

Do not redesign the platform.
Do not add unrelated features.
Do not produce another narrative.
Execute item by item until every core gate is PASS.

CURRENTLY VERIFIED:
- Direct GitHub write = PASS
- CI = PASS
- Direct Render deploy = PASS
- SHA parity = TRUE
- Playwright = PASS
- Independent clean build = PASS
- Autonomous independent task = PASS
- Backend tests = PASS
- Expo tests = PASS
- Security = PASS
- Supabase/Auth = PASS
- Owner login = PASS
- Member registration = PASS
- Public chat = PASS
- Owner AI = PASS
- Queue/worker = PASS
- Failure recovery = PASS
- Rork runtime/git/deploy/build dependencies = 0
- Rork SDK/toolkit/env/network = 0

REMAINING CORE GAPS:
1. Soak test incomplete
2. Android device QA not executed
3. Secret/runtime binding ambiguity
4. Multiple autonomous task repeatability not yet deeply proven
5. Long-session/chat-memory QA not yet fully proven
6. Repeated failure-recovery/load QA needs final pass
7. Final post-test regression + SHA parity + zero-Rork verification

==================================================
ITEM 1 — COMPLETE EXISTING SOAK TEST
==================================================

Do not restart the current soak monitor unless invalid.

Verify:
- monitor PID/process alive
- results file updating
- no long sample gaps
- current production SHA unchanged

Complete the full required 2 real hours.

Return:

SOAK_START=
SOAK_END=
SOAK_DURATION=
REQUESTS=
SUCCESS=
FAILURES=
4XX=
5XX=
TIMEOUTS=
RESTARTS=
QUEUE_STALLS=
DATABASE_FAILURES=
PROVIDER_FAILURES=
P50=
P95=
P99=
MAX_LATENCY=

Classify cold starts separately.

Required:
SOAK_TEST=PASS

If the soak monitor is still running:
continue with Items 2–6 in parallel.

==================================================
ITEM 2 — RESOLVE SECRET/RUNTIME BINDING
==================================================

Investigate IVX_AI_SYSTEM_SECRET and any equivalent owner-auth/runtime secret.

Do NOT ask owner to recreate or paste credentials first.

Determine:

VARIABLE_PRESENT=
BOUND_TO_PRODUCTION=
BOUND_TO_WORKER=
BOUND_TO_CURRENT_SHELL=
ACTUALLY_REQUIRED_FOR_RUNTIME=
AUTH_TEST_HTTP_STATUS=
ERROR_CATEGORY=

If it exists in production but not in the shell:
this is a binding/context issue, not a credential failure.

Fix the binding if needed.

Only request credential replacement if a real request proves:
- missing in actual runtime
- 401
- 403
- revoked
- expired

Required:
SECRET_BINDING_STATUS=PASS
or
NOT_REQUIRED_WITH_EVIDENCE

==================================================
ITEM 3 — MULTIPLE AUTONOMOUS REAL TASKS
==================================================

One successful autonomous task is not enough.

Run 5 additional real, production-safe engineering tasks across different IVX modules.

Allowed examples:
- IVX IA Chat reliability
- auth/session handling
- investor module
- business/deal module
- mobile UX
- queue/worker observability

Not allowed:
- proof-only files
- labels
- timestamps
- comments-only
- sentinel strings

For EACH task require:

analyze
→ code
→ tests
→ direct GitHub commit
→ CI
→ merge
→ direct Render deploy
→ /health
→ /version
→ functional verification

Capture:

TASK_ID
JOB_ID
MODULE
FILES_CHANGED
TEST_RESULT
COMMIT_SHA
CI_RUN_ID
MERGE_SHA
DEPLOY_ID
PRODUCTION_SHA
SHA_PARITY
RORK_CALLS

Required for all 5:
PASS
SHA_PARITY=TRUE
RORK_CALLS=0

Final:
AUTONOMOUS_REPEATABILITY=PASS

==================================================
ITEM 4 — IVX IA CHAT DEEP QA
==================================================

Run production QA on real chat behavior.

Test:
- new conversation
- existing conversation
- 10-turn context
- 25-turn context
- 50-turn context
- reload
- app restart
- session renewal
- background/foreground
- slow network
- temporary provider delay
- temporary Supabase delay
- duplicate send
- rapid send
- retry
- logout/login restore

Verify:
- no blank screen
- no infinite loading
- no message loss
- no duplicates
- correct ordering
- composer remains usable
- history restores
- context retained
- errors recover cleanly

Return:
CHAT_QA_TOTAL=
CHAT_QA_PASS=
CHAT_QA_FAIL=
CONTEXT_10=
CONTEXT_25=
CONTEXT_50=
MESSAGE_LOSS=
DUPLICATES=
ORDER_ERRORS=
RECOVERY=

Required:
IVX_CHAT_DEEP_QA=PASS

==================================================
ITEM 5 — MULTIPLE FAILURE-RECOVERY TESTS
==================================================

Run controlled safe failures:

1. worker restart
2. provider timeout
3. Supabase timeout
4. stale branch
5. failed test
6. delayed Render deploy
7. SHA mismatch simulation in staging/test context
8. malformed autonomous task
9. duplicate task submission

Verify:
- exact error captured
- correct stage identified
- bounded retries
- no duplicate commit
- no duplicate PR
- no duplicate deploy
- durable state
- recovery completes
- false success = 0

Required:
FAILURE_RECOVERY_SUITE=PASS

==================================================
ITEM 6 — PERFORMANCE / LOAD
==================================================

Run safe production or staging load tests.

Test:
- 20 concurrent users
- 50 concurrent users
- 100 concurrent users if safe

Measure:
P50
P95
P99
ERROR_RATE
TIMEOUT_RATE
AI_TTFT
TOTAL_AI_LATENCY
DB_LATENCY
QUEUE_LATENCY

Separate:
- warm performance
- cold-start performance

Required:
- no persistent 5xx
- no queue deadlock
- no auth outage
- no provider stuck state
- no memory/crash loop

Return:
LOAD_TEST=PASS/FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 7 — ANDROID DEVICE QA
==================================================

Use the already-built signed APK if it matches final GitHub SHA.

If not, rebuild from final GitHub SHA.

Run on:
- physical Android device preferred
or
- valid KVM/device farm/emulator

Test:
- install
- launch
- registration
- login
- logout
- session restore
- IVX IA Chat
- business modules
- background/foreground
- offline
- reconnect
- slow network
- app restart
- push/notification if applicable
- no Rork network calls
- no crash

Return:
BUILD_SHA=
DEVICE=
ANDROID_VERSION=
INSTALL=
LAUNCH=
AUTH=
CHAT=
RECOVERY=
CRASHES=
RORK_REQUESTS=

Required:
ANDROID_DEVICE_QA=PASS

If the environment truly cannot provide a device:
mark
ANDROID_DEVICE_QA=EXTERNAL_DEVICE_REQUIRED

Do not mark PASS without a real device/emulator test.

==================================================
ITEM 8 — FINAL SECURITY REGRESSION
==================================================

Verify:
- unauthenticated = 401
- unauthorized = 403
- authorized owner = PASS
- member isolation
- rate limiting
- JWT/session validation
- expired token behavior
- secret redaction
- audit logging
- branch protection
- no public secret leakage

Required:
SECURITY_REGRESSION=PASS

==================================================
ITEM 9 — FINAL ZERO-RORK VERIFICATION
==================================================

After all tests and autonomous tasks, rerun:

RORK_RUNTIME_DEPENDENCIES
RORK_GIT_DEPENDENCIES
RORK_DEPLOY_DEPENDENCIES
RORK_BUILD_DEPENDENCIES
RORK_SDK_IMPORTS
RORK_TOOLKIT_CALLS
RORK_ACTIVE_ENV_VARS
RORK_NETWORK_REQUEST_COUNT

All must equal 0.

==================================================
ITEM 10 — FINAL SHA PARITY
==================================================

Collect:

LOCAL_SHA
GITHUB_SHA
RENDER_SHA
HEALTH_SHA
VERSION_SHA

Required:
all identical

Return:
SHA_PARITY=TRUE

==================================================
ITEM 11 — FINAL REGRESSION
==================================================

Run from the FINAL SHA:

- root TypeScript
- backend TypeScript
- Expo TypeScript
- lint
- backend tests
- Expo tests
- integration
- Playwright
- auth
- member registration
- owner login
- public chat
- owner AI
- investors
- buyer discovery
- deal tracking
- queue
- worker
- security
- failure recovery

Required:
FINAL_REGRESSION=PASS

==================================================
FINAL CORE CERTIFICATION
==================================================

Return ONLY:

SOAK_TEST=
SECRET_BINDING_STATUS=
AUTONOMOUS_REPEATABILITY=
IVX_CHAT_DEEP_QA=
FAILURE_RECOVERY_SUITE=
LOAD_TEST=
ANDROID_DEVICE_QA=
SECURITY_REGRESSION=
SHA_PARITY=
FINAL_REGRESSION=

RORK_RUNTIME_DEPENDENCIES=
RORK_GIT_DEPENDENCIES=
RORK_DEPLOY_DEPENDENCIES=
RORK_BUILD_DEPENDENCIES=
RORK_NETWORK_REQUEST_COUNT=

FAIL=
PARTIAL=
IN_PROGRESS=
BLOCKED=
NOT_EXECUTED=
NOT_VERIFIED=

IOS_TESTFLIGHT=DEFERRED_BY_OWNER
APP_STORE=DEFERRED_BY_OWNER
GOOGLE_PLAY=DEFERRED_BY_OWNER

FINAL_VERDICT=

Allowed final verdicts:

IVX CORE PLATFORM 100% VERIFIED

or

IVX CORE PLATFORM NOT YET 100% VERIFIED

IVX CORE PLATFORM 100% VERIFIED requires:

SOAK_TEST=PASS
SECRET_BINDING_STATUS=PASS or NOT_REQUIRED_WITH_EVIDENCE
AUTONOMOUS_REPEATABILITY=PASS
IVX_CHAT_DEEP_QA=PASS
FAILURE_RECOVERY_SUITE=PASS
LOAD_TEST=PASS
ANDROID_DEVICE_QA=PASS
SECURITY_REGRESSION=PASS
SHA_PARITY=TRUE
FINAL_REGRESSION=PASS

ALL RORK COUNTERS=0

FAIL=0
PARTIAL=0
IN_PROGRESS=0
BLOCKED=0
NOT_EXECUTED=0
NOT_VERIFIED=0

iOS/TestFlight/App Store/Google Play do not count against this core certification because the owner explicitly deferred store-release work.

DO NOT STOP BETWEEN ITEMS.
EXECUTE ITEM BY ITEM.
NO NARRATIVE.
NO PERCENTAGE.
EVIDENCE ONLY.
